map.每格数字 = 其周围 8 格中的地雷数；标雷后揭开所有安全格获胜。首点通常有保护: Each number is the count of mines in the surrounding 8 cells; flag the mines and reveal every safe cell to win. The first click is usually protected (no mine). Empty cells (0 mines) expand their neighbors automatically. ...

map.首点一定安全吗？: Is the first click always safe?

map.怎么提高胜率？: How to improve the win rate?
